webhooks.summary: Linear exposes a REST webhook management API (separate from its GraphQL API) for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting webhooks. The OpenAPI content confirms webhook support but does not formally enumerate event names, webhook payload schemas, callback definitions, or signature header specifications.

managementEndpoints.description: List all webhooks for the authenticated workspace
Retrieve a specific webhook by ID
Update webhook URL, secret, enabled status, or resource types

signature.detail: The updateWebhook (PATCH /webhooks/{webhookId}) operation description references a 'secret' field that can be set, which strongly implies Linear supports HMAC-based payload signing with a shared secret. However, the specific signature header name and hashing algorithm are not documented in the provided OpenAPI content.

setupSteps.title: Obtain your registry inbound hook URL
setupSteps.detail: In the package registry, navigate to your workspace's webhooks settings area and copy the stable inbound hook URL provided for triggering workflows.

setupSteps.title: Authenticate with the Linear API
setupSteps.detail: Use a Linear API key or OAuth token to authenticate requests against the Linear REST API. Refer to https://developers.linear.app for authentication details.

setupSteps.title: Create a webhook via the Linear REST API
setupSteps.detail: Send a POST request to /webhooks with the registry's inbound hook URL as the callback URL. Include the desired resource types (e.g., issues, comments, projects, cycles) and, if supported by the full API schema, set a secret value for payload signature verification. Store the returned webhook ID for future management.

setupSteps.title: Verify webhook delivery (if a secret was configured)
setupSteps.detail: If Linear signs payloads using the configured secret, ensure your registry/workflow validates the incoming signature header on each webhook delivery. Note: the exact header name and verification algorithm are not specified in the provided OpenAPI content; consult Linear's full developer documentation at https://developers.linear.app for signature verification specifics.

setupSteps.title: Confirm the hook is registered
setupSteps.detail: Send GET /webhooks (or GET /webhooks/{webhookId} with the ID from step 3) to confirm the webhook is active and points at your registry hook URL. The webhook should now appear in the registry webhooks area as a registered provider hook.
